result.rationale: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1, which over-counts by one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 100 members, limit 50 → totalPages=3 though only 2 pages exist). showingLast (propertyEqual of currentPage and totalPages) then never triggers on the actual last page, so 'next' stays enabled; conversely 'next' can advance offset to user_count (Math.min in the next action) yielding an empty page. A Math.ceil computation is required.

adjudication.rationale: `totalPages` in `admin-group.js.es6` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 100/50 => 3 pages instead of 2). Since `showingLast` is `propertyEqual("currentPage", "totalPages")`, it will not become true on the actual last non-empty page. The `next` action can also set `offset` to `user_count`, making `currentPage` advance to the inflated page number and potentially fetching an empty member list (`offset=100` for 100 users).
